      github.event.pull_request.base.ref == github.event.repository.default_branch &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'release/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out trusted release validation
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |-
            scripts/validate-release-pr.mts
            scripts/release-github-evidence.mts
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Validate version-only release change
        env:
          GITHUB_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          RELEASE_PR_MODE: pre-merge
          RELEASE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node scripts/validate-release-pr.mts

  verify:
    name: Verification (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          # Architecture validates the exact event base/head and accepted epic history.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run policy, type, and test verification
        env:
          HVIR_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: npm run verify

  electron-smoke:
    name: Electron smoke (Linux)
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run production Electron workflow
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/production
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke

      - name: Run development renderer Performance Timeline containment
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/development-performance
        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:development-performance

        run: xvfb-run -a npm run smoke:isolation

      - name: Upload bounded Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  macos-electron-smoke:
    # Temporary reduced gate: terminal-presentation, terminal-lifecycle, and capacity
    # remain available through local commands while their macOS flakes are hardened.
    name: Electron correctness (macOS arm64; temporary reduced gate)
    needs: release-version-integrity

    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run focused unpackaged Electron scenarios
        env:
          HVIR_SMOKE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts/macos-ci
        run: npm run smoke:macos:ci

      - name: Upload bounded macOS Electron failure evidence
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-macos-electron-smoke-failure-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/hvir-smoke-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  codeql:
    name: CodeQL analysis
    needs: release-version-integrity
    if: always() && needs.release-version-integrity.result == 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      packages: read
      security-events: write

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v4.37.9
        with:
          languages: javascript-typescript

      - name: Analyze
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v4.37.9

  merge-acceptance:
    name: Merge acceptance
    needs:
      - release-version-integrity
      - verify
      - electron-smoke
      - macos-electron-smoke

      let root: HostPath
      let terminalId: string
      if (req.source === 'terminal') {

        if (
          !terminal ||
          terminal.ownerId !== owner.id ||
          terminal.ownerGeneration !== owner.generation ||
          terminal.hostId !== root.hostId ||
          !hostPathEquals(terminal.workspaceRoot, root)
        ) {
          throw new Error('Web pane source terminal is not live in this workspace')
        }
      } else {
        if (!isWebPaneId(req.paneId)) throw new Error('Invalid source web pane')
        const source = deps.webPanes.source(req.paneId, owner.id, owner.generation)

  status=$?
  echo "hvir package configuration failed while $stage" >&2
  exit "$status"

  if [ -L '/usr/bin/${executable}' ] &&
    [ -e '/usr/bin/${executable}' ] &&
    [ "$(readlink '/usr/bin/${executable}')" != '/etc/alternatives/${executable}' ]; then
    rm -f '/usr/bin/${executable}'
  fi
  update-alternatives \
    --install '/usr/bin/${executable}' '${executable}' \
    "$HVIR_COMMAND" 100
else
  ln -sf "$HVIR_COMMAND" '/usr/bin/${executable}'
fi

stage='configuring the Chromium sandbox helper'
chown root:root '/opt/${sanitizedProductName}/chrome-sandbox'
if command -v runuser >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
  runuser -u nobody -- unshare --user ****** >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  chmod 0755 '/opt/${sanitizedProductName}/chrome-sandbox'

  chmod 4755 '/opt/${sanitizedProductName}/chrome-sandbox'

  update-desktop-database /usr/share/applications

    apparmor_parser --remove "$APPARMOR_PROFILE_TARGET"
  fi
  rm -f "$APPARMOR_PROFILE_TARGET"
fi

trap - ERR

+# hvir
+
+hvir is a desktop workbench for working with projects, terminals, and coding
+sessions. It brings local and SSH-hosted projects, files, Git, and terminal
+workflows together in one Electron application.
+
+## Features
+
+- Open local projects or connect to an SSH host and browse for a project folder.
+  SSH host entries are read from `~/.ssh/config`.
+- Work across project workspaces and Git worktrees with split terminal and file
+  viewer layouts.
+- Browse and edit files, inspect Git changes and history, switch branches, fetch,
+  and pull.
+- Open web panes from terminal links and review documents with inline comments.
+- Configure coding harness profiles and view terminal sessions across workspaces.
+
+## Getting started
+
+The native packages target macOS arm64 (`.pkg`) and Linux x64 and arm64 (`.deb`).
+After installing a package, launch hvir from your applications menu and choose a
+local or SSH host and a project folder. The installed `hvir` command can also
+open a local project:
+
+```sh
+hvir /path/to/project
+```
+
+## Development
+
+Requirements:
+
+- Node.js 24 or newer and npm.
+- Git for repository workflows.
+- A native build toolchain for Node.js addons (including Python and a C/C++
+  compiler). On macOS, install the Xcode command line tools.
+
+Install dependencies and start the development app:
+
+```sh
+npm ci
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Installation downloads Electron and rebuilds native modules for its runtime.
+The application uses Electron, React, TypeScript, and electron-vite.
+
+### Build and package
+
+```sh
+npm run build              # Type-check and build the application
+npm run preview            # Run the built application
+npm run build:dir          # Create an unpacked application in dist/
+npm run pack:mac:arm64     # Build a macOS arm64 .pkg
+npm run pack:linux:x64     # Build a Linux x64 .deb
+npm run pack:linux:arm64   # Build a Linux arm64 .deb
+```
+
+Packaging requires the appropriate platform-specific build tools. Signed macOS
+packages additionally require a configured signing identity; the
+`pack:mac:arm64:signed` script enforces code signing.
+
+### Checks
+
+```sh
+npm test                   # Vitest suite
+npm run typecheck          # Node and renderer TypeScript checks
+npm run lint               # ESLint
+npm run verify             # Repository policy, lint, type-check, and tests
+npm run smoke              # Electron smoke scenarios
+```
+
+Electron smoke tests require a graphical session; CI uses `xvfb-run -a npm run
+smoke` on Linux. See `package.json` for focused smoke scenarios and other
+development scripts.
+
+## Project layout
+
+- `src/main/` — Electron main process, project hosts, terminals, Git, and IPC.
+- `src/preload/` — the bridge between the renderer and main process.
+- `src/renderer/` — React workbench UI.
+- `src/shared/` — shared types and contracts.
+- `src/workers/` — worker processes.
+- `test/` — automated tests; `scripts/` contains build and verification tools.
+
+## License
+
+hvir is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). See
+[THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for third-party notices.
*** End Patch
